title: Aye Chand Karbala Ke
body:
AY CHAND KARBALA KE TUNE TO DEKHE HONGE
UTRE THE IS ZAMEEN PAR ARSHE BAREEN KE TAARE
AY CHAND...
<<DIVIDER>>
1.AY CHAND JALWA GAR HAI HASHIM KA CHAND YAAN PAR
KHAIRAAT ROSHNI KI LE LIJIO YAHAN SE
<<MINI>>
AY CHAND...
<<DIVIDER>>
2.AY CHAND ISS ZAMEEN PAR RAKHIO HUMESHA THANDAK
SOTE JO HAIN YAHAN PAR ZEHRA KE HAIN YE PYAARE
<<MINI>>
AY CHAND...
<<DIVIDER>>
3.TASNEEMO SALSABILO KAUSAR KE HAIN YE MAALIK
MAARE GAYE JO PYAASE ISS NAHER KE KINAARE
<<MINI>>
AY CHAND...
<<DIVIDER>>
4.HUR AUR HABIB JAISE JAANBAAZ AUR AHIBBA
MAARE GAYE YAHEEN PAR ANSAAR SHAAHE DEEN KE
<<MINI>>
AY CHAND...
<<DIVIDER>>
5.MAARE GAYE YAHEEN PAR BE DARDIO SITAM SE
MUSLIM KE DONO PYARE ZAINAB KE DONO BETE
<<MINI>>
AY CHAND...
<<DIVIDER>>
6.PAMAAL HO RAHI THI QASIM KI LAASH RUN MEIN
ABBAS AUR SARWAR CHUNTE THE UNKE TUKDE
<<MINI>>
AY CHAND...
<<DIVIDER>>
7.BAZU KATE YAHEEN PAR ABBASE BAWAFA KE
IZNE WAGA NA PAYA PANI BHI LA NA PAAYE
<<MINI>>
AY CHAND...
<<DIVIDER>>
8.IS SARZAMEEN PA GUZRA SARWAR PA YE BHI SADMA
SEENE PA KHAYEE BARCHI HUM SHAKLE MUSTAFA NE
<<MINI>>
AY CHAND...
<<DIVIDER>>
9.PAANI PILANE LAYE IK MEHLAKA KO SARWAR
KIA ZABHA HURMULANE TEERE SITAM LAGA KE
GARDAN CHHIDI PISAR KI BAZU CHHIDA PADAR KA
DONO TADAP TADAP KAR PYAASE JAHAAN SE GUZRE
<<MINI>>
AY CHAND...
<<DIVIDER>>
10.IS BUN MEIN EK BACHCHI BABA KO DHOONDTI THI
BIKHRE HUWE PADE THE JAB SAR BURIDA LAASHE
PHIR YE BHI TUM NE DEKHA WO GHUM RASIDA BACHCHI
SEENE PE SO RAHI THI BE SAR PADAR SE LIPTI
<<MINI>>
AY CHAND...
<<DIVIDER>>
11.BAZU BANDHE YAHEEN PAR PEHLE PAHEL HARAM KE
ISS SAR ZAMEEN SE NIKLE SAJJAD SAR JHUKAYE
<<MINI>>
AY CHAND...
<<DIVIDER>>
12.SHEHZAAD-E-JINAA HI MALIK HAI KARBALA KA
KIS KI MAJAAL AAYE AB TAK NA WO BULAAYE
PAHONCHE HAIN KARBALA MEIN JO LOG SIBTE JAFAR
AY KAASH PHIR MUQADDAR UNKO YE DIN DIKHAAYE
<<MINI>>
AY CHAND KARBALA KE TUNE TO DEKHE HONGE
UTRE THE IS ZAMEEN PAR ARSHE BAREEN KE TAARE
